findings.issue: `hpre` (`(unitsEquiv hE).symm ⟨scalar a, scalar_mem hE a⟩ = Units.map (algebraMap F E) a`) is a fact about `GL2NonSplitTorus.unitsEquiv` itself, proved inline inside a character computation; any restriction of a torus character to the centre needs it.

summary: Proofs are short and rewrite-based on stable lemmas; the one real issue is that three reusable facts (two units-level Frobenius identities and the preimage of a scalar under `unitsEquiv`) are proved inline as `have`s inside theorem bodies where later steps of this roadmap will need them again.
